misc: A bombed-out multistorey building in Gaza City, weakened by earlier Israeli strikes and sheltering displaced families, collapsed. Rescuers said the search for dozens more was hampered by a lack of heavy machinery. Source: The Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/16/building-gaza-city-damaged-israeli-strikes-collapses-killed

Iranian FM Araghchi met Chinese FM Wang Yi in Beijing. China called for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and avoiding spillover into Yemen and the Red Sea, after private Chinese requests (urged by Saudi Arabia) that Iran 'rein in' the Houthis. The same day the CBO put US war spending at over $38 billion from Feb 28 to Aug 1. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-16-2026/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-17-2026/ ; Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war

target: Saudi Aramco refinery, Yanbu; King Khalid Air Base, Khamis Mushait
misc: FOG OF WAR: The Houthis announced missile and drone attacks on the Aramco refinery at Yanbu and King Khalid Air Base. On Sep 15 Saudi air defences intercepted a Houthi drone near Mecca, showing the campaign's growing reach. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-16-2026/

Shopkeepers across northwestern Iran went on strike on the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death. The regime has deployed security forces in several cities amid economic crisis and fuel price rises. Location approximate (Kermanshah). Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-16-2026/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-8-2026/

structuralDmg: Trend caught fire and stopped (IRGC); Panama-flagged ship damaged.
misc: Iran fired projectiles at two tankers transiting Hormuz on Sep 16-17. The IRGC said it hit a Togo-flagged vessel (Trend) making an 'illegal passage', which caught fire and stopped. UKMTO reported a security incident near Oman. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-18-2026/ ; Wikipedia Hormuz crisis https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis ; Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war

target: King Fahd Air Base; Taif city
structuralDmg: Italian Eurofighter Typhoon damaged at the base (Italian sources via ISW).
humanCasualties: 1 killed, 2 injured by falling debris from an intercepted drone over Taif (Saudi authorities, via Anadolu).
misc: A Houthi attack on King Fahd Air Base in Taif damaged an Italian Eurofighter Typhoon, and debris from a drone intercepted over Taif killed one person. Italy said it is preparing to send warships on its own to protect Italian shipping through Bab al-Mandeb. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-22-2026/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-23-2026/ ; Anadolu https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/yemen-s-houthis-claim-missile-drone-attacks-on-saudi-capital/4062167 ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-18-2026/

Trump told Axios he faces a 'big decision' between resuming large-scale strikes on Iran or pursuing a deal to end the nearly seven-month war, and said he would consult the six GCC leaders at the UN General Assembly first. Source: Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war

structuralDmg: Rapid reconstruction at Taleghan 2 with concrete and tarps; earthen barriers and soil over tunnel entrances at Natanz.
misc: Satellite imagery cited by ISW shows Iran rapidly rebuilding the Taleghan 2 facility at Parchin and strengthening passive defences at Natanz and Pickaxe Mountain between Sep 11 and 17. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-17-2026/

UK military reported a vessel hit by an 'unknown projectile' in Hormuz, identified as the STI Steadfast. Source: Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war ; Wikipedia Hormuz crisis https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis

Iran held a 313,000-person Basij 'Janfada' exercise and parade in Tehran Province, with women's units and drone demonstrations, alongside the largest government-organised rally since the war began. ISW says the regime is building a population-based reserve. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-18-2026/ ; Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war

target: 'Sensitive sites' in Riyadh; Aramco facilities in Yanbu
structuralDmg: Fuel tank fire at a depot near King Khalid International Airport (AFP).
misc: The Houthis claimed missile and drone strikes on Riyadh and Aramco's Yanbu facilities after an overnight air-raid alert. AFP saw firefighters put out a blaze at an Aramco-marked fuel tank near Riyadh airport. The Guardian reported 75 Houthi fighters killed the same day. Source: Kurdistan24 (AFP) https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/940514/houthis-claim-missile-and-drone-strikes-on-riyadh-yanbu-oil-facilities ; The Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/20/middle-east-braces-for-more-violence-as-iran-claims-us-is-planning-to-renew-bombing-campaign

target: Civilians; vehicle in Sheikh Radwan market
humanCasualties: 4 killed incl. Basir al-Bursh, son of Gaza Health Ministry director-general Munir al-Bursh (medical sources via Al Jazeera).
misc: Israeli drone strikes killed three Palestinians in Gaza on Sep 19, and a fourth died of wounds. Among the dead was the eldest son of Gaza health director-general Munir al-Bursh, killed in Jabalia. Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/19/three-palestinians-killed-in-israeli-strikes-across-gaza ; BSS https://www.bssnews.net/international/426283

CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper said US forces have enabled more than one billion barrels of crude to leave the Gulf through Hormuz in recent months. IRGC personnel were reported visiting newly captured Houthi coastal territory near Mokha to oversee tunnel building and discuss radars. Source: Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-21-2026/

target: Houthi targets (planned strikes not carried out)
misc: FOG OF WAR: The called-off strikes are based on press reports. Trump reportedly decided at the last minute not to strike Houthi targets in Yemen 'for the time being' and cut short a Camp David weekend. He told Fox News he was considering 'wiping Iran out'. Iran claimed intelligence that the US was preparing to renew bombing, and the State Department issued a new security alert for the region. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-21-2026/ ; The Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/20/middle-east-braces-for-more-violence-as-iran-claims-us-is-planning-to-renew-bombing-campaign

humanCasualties: 2 crew injured across the Sep 20-22 attacks (Wikipedia; a tanker attack on Sep 21 lightly injured two crew).
misc: The Liberia-flagged Al Maryah was attacked while leaving Hormuz. A tanker was attacked on Sep 21 (two crew lightly hurt), and the Isle of Man-flagged LR Stephanie was damaged on Sep 22. Source: Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war ; Wikipedia Hormuz crisis https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-21-2026/

humanCasualties: 1 Palestinian killed by Israeli forces; 1 Israeli settler shot dead near Halamish (Al Jazeera).
misc: Israeli forces killed a Palestinian man near Ganim settlement east of Jenin after what the army called an attempted car-ramming. Separately, an Israeli settler was shot dead near Halamish in the central West Bank. Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/20/israeli-forces-kill-palestinian-near-jenin-in-occupied-west-bank

At UNGA, Witkoff and Kushner held a three-hour meeting with FM Araghchi through Qatari mediators; Iranian state TV confirmed Araghchi met Witkoff. Trump called it 'very productive', yet in his UN speech asked whether he should 'annihilate the Islamic Republic' and predicted a deal after the November elections. Tehran's conditions include an end to the war on all fronts. Source: BBC https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c52e0ywl9pr7o ; Axios https://www.axios.com/2026/09/22/unga-iran-us-trump-war ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-23-2026/

city: Jabal Kahbub (Taiz-Lahij border) and other fronts
weapon: Ground combat; Saudi air and artillery strikes
humanCasualties: Up to 169 killed Sep 20-22: at least 118 per Houthi officials (AFP), at least 36 government side per government sources (Guardian).
misc: Heavy fighting for the Kahbub heights overlooking the Red Sea coast and other fronts (Taiz, Jawf, Marib, Saada) killed up to 169 people in three days, and thousands fled. Government forces held positions near Jabal Kahbub after retaking it on Sep 17. Location approximate. Source: The Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/22/yemen-houthis-battle-strategic-red-sea-heights ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-22-2026/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-17-2026/

target: Antigua and Barbuda-flagged bulk carrier Cape Dao (UAE-managed)
structuralDmg: Engine-room fire; ship abandoned; later sank on Oct 14 per Wikipedia.
humanCasualties: 1 Indian seafarer killed; 27 crew evacuated by the Royal Navy of Oman (gCaptain).
misc: Cape Dao, carrying coal to India, was hit by an unknown projectile in Hormuz at 06:30 UTC and abandoned after an engine-room fire, as US-Iran talks reopened at the UN. Source: gCaptain https://gcaptain.com/seafarer-killed-in-hormuz-attack-as-trump-pushes-iran-deal-at-un/ ; Seatrade Maritime https://www.seatrade-maritime.com/security/seafarer-dead-in-attack-on-uae-managed-bulker ; Lloyd's List https://www.lloydslist.com/LL1158520/UPDATED-Seafarer-killed-in-latest-Hormuz-attack

humanCasualties: IRGC Brig. Gen. Hossein Zarifi (Shahid Sajjad base, Saravan) killed per IRGC/Tasnim; 5 insurgents killed per IRNA; a second officer (Ahmad Zeraati) reported killed only by Baloch rights group Haalvsh.
misc: FOG OF WAR: Baloch militants and IRGC forces clashed around Jihadabad, Saravan, in a counterinsurgency operation; the IRGC confirmed the death of Brig. Gen. Hossein Zarifi. A second killed officer is reported only by an opposition rights group. Source: The National https://thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/09/24/irgc-commander-killed-in-clashes-with-gunmen-in-irans-restive-south-east ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-24-2026/ ; https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-23-2026/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war

humanCasualties: Houthis claim 'hundreds' of Saudi, Yemeni and Sudanese soldiers killed or injured; Saudi Arabia has not acknowledged.
misc: FOG OF WAR: Casualty claim from the Houthi spokesman only; unacknowledged by Riyadh. The Houthis said they launched 'preemptive' strikes on a Saudi border base at al-Tuwal over a reported Saudi troop build-up, and attacked again on Sep 24. Government forces pushed back a Houthi advance aimed at cutting the Taiz-Aden road the same day. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-24-2026/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-25-2026/

A report cited by ISW said Chinese aircraft delivered about 1,300 shipments of dual-use technology (GPS trackers, electric motors, engine and flight-control parts) to Iran's Defence Ministry between January and June 2026. Map point nominal (Tehran). Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-24-2026/

weapon: Ground forces; demolitions; artillery and air strikes
target: Hezbollah infrastructure; villages south of the Litani
structuralDmg: Demolitions in more than 60 occupied towns (Al Jazeera).
humanCasualties: Lebanese Health Ministry toll: 4,386 killed, 12,413 wounded Mar 2 - Sep 25.
misc: The IDF cut its ground presence in southern Lebanon from eight to six brigades after meeting operational objectives (ISW). Israeli shelling and demolitions continued around Froun, Taybeh and Deir Siryan. On Sep 25 PM Nawaf Salam told the UN he wants the ceasefire consolidated, full Israeli withdrawal and state control of all weapons. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-24-2026/ ; Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/25/israeli-shelling-continues-as-lebanons-pm-demands-withdrawal-in-un-speech ; Shafaq News https://shafaq.com/en/Middle-East/Israeli-army-strikes-multiple-villages-in-southern-Lebanon

weapon: Six ballistic missiles and a drone
target: Saudi energy infrastructure at Yanbu; Riyadh 'sensitive target' (claimed)
misc: Saudi air defences and a Greek-operated Patriot battery intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles and a drone near Taif and Yanbu; the Houthis claimed hits on Riyadh and Aramco Yanbu. France announced it would send troops, radars and military assets to protect Yanbu's energy infrastructure. Source: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/houthis-say-they-attacked-riyadh-aramco-facilities-yanbu-2026-09-24/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-24-2026/ ; ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-25-2026/

On the UNGA sidelines Araghchi offered a seven-day roadmap: Iran would reopen Hormuz and resume nuclear talks by day seven if the US lifts its naval blockade, waives oil sanctions and observes a ceasefire including Lebanon, conditions he said already sit in the June MOU. Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/25/iran-pitches-seven-day-roadmap-to-end-conflict-with-us ; PBS NewsHour https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-has-suggested-a-deal-to-reopen-the-strait-of-hormuz-in-7-days ; BBC https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqgmrr9ekr7ko

weapon: Ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones
target: Aramco refinery, Yanbu; unspecified target in Riyadh
misc: The Houthis launched another missile and drone salvo at the Aramco refinery in Yanbu and at Riyadh, while attacking near the Taiz-Aden road, which government forces kept control of. The Saudi Grand Mufti urged forces to defeat the Houthis after the Sep 24 al-Tuwal attack. Source: ISW https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-september-25-2026/

Trump rejected Iran's seven-day Hormuz proposal on Sep 26 at the White House, saying 'I reject their proposal', that it would not be acceptable and that Iran wants a deal 'because they are losing so badly'; a White House official said the US has control of the Strait of Hormuz. Araghchi said Tehran 'will not back down' and was awaiting mediators' 'definitive views'. Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/09/26/trump-rejects-irans-seven-day-roadmap-to-reopen-strait-of-hormuz ; ITV https://www.itv.com/news/2026-09-26/donald-trump-rejects-irans-latest-proposal-to-reopen-strait-of-hormuz ; https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqgmrr9ekr7ko ; https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-irgc-ready-counteroffensive-us-attacks/?id=136611503 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war

city: Strait of Hormuz (southern route via Omani waters)
target: 19 vessels using the US-backed southern corridor (claimed)
misc: FOG OF WAR: The 19-ship figure is an Iranian claim; independent incident reports for Sep 25-26 were not found. Iran said its forces 'targeted' or 'intercepted' 19 ships over Sep 25-26 for using an 'unauthorized' US-backed southern route through Omani waters. UKMTO later published late reports of four tankers struck on Sep 28-29. IRGC Navy deputy Ali Mohammadi warned Iran would hit US ships in the Indian Ocean if heavy fighting resumes. Source: Seatrade Maritime https://www.seatrade-maritime.com/security/four-vessels-struck-in-hormuz-in-24-hours ; Anadolu (Facebook) https://www.facebook.com/anadoluagencyenglish/posts/iranian-forces-over-the-past-2-days-intercepted-19-ships-that-tried-to-pass-thro/1430437975941881/ ; ABC News https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-irgc-ready-counteroffensive-us-attacks/?id=136611503

FOG OF WAR: The drone seizure is an IRGC claim; no US confirmation found. The IRGC Navy claimed to have seized a US Remus 600 underwater drone in Hormuz, its second such claim this month. Trump said he expects more talks with Iran this week, is 'always thinking about' new strikes, and claimed over 20 million barrels moved through Hormuz over the weekend. Araghchi said Iran is ready for diplomacy but would stand firm 'even if it comes to a doomsday war'. Source: ABC News https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-irgc-ready-counteroffensive-us-attacks/?id=136611503 ; Wikipedia timeline https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Iran_war ; Wikipedia Hormuz crisis https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis

weapon: Petrol found in three vans; explosives suspected
target: RAF Fairford (US bomber base used against Iran)
humanCasualties: None; five British men arrested, later bailed; no charges.
misc: In the early hours of Sept 27 police arrested five British men in their 20s near RAF Fairford, a base used by US bombers to strike Iran, on suspected terrorism/explosives offences; petrol was found in three linked vans. A British-Iranian man was arrested Oct 1; the US later moved B-1/B-52 bombers out of Fairford. Iran denied involvement. Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/12/uk-blames-iran-for-airbase-plot-sanctions-two-iranian-nationals ; GlobalSecurity (RFE/RL) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/09-28_index.htm

Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators on the UNGA sidelines in New York to discuss proposals to end the war with the US, and also met UN Secretary-General Guterres. Iran's 7-point plan (reopen Hormuz within seven days in exchange for ending the US blockade, sanctions relief, unfrozen assets, non-aggression guarantees and a regional ceasefire incl. Lebanon and Yemen) was conveyed via Qatar; Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued a statement insisting Iran remains custodian of Hormuz. Source: GlobalSecurity (RFE/RL, UN SG readouts) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/09-28_index.htm ; Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/4/new-aircraft-carrier-10000-us-troops-is-the-iran-war-about-to-escalate

humanCasualties: Press TV reported 8 US Marines injured in a 'recent' Iranian attack; not confirmed by US.
misc: FOG OF WAR: Iranian state outlet Press TV reported that eight US Marines were injured in a recent Iranian attack on American forces near the Strait of Hormuz; no US confirmation found and the attack date is unclear. Same day the IRGC spokesman said Hormuz 'is not open' and had become a 'hunting ground' for US underwater vehicles. Source: GlobalSecurity (Press TV, IRNA) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/09-28_index.htm

target: Hamas northern Gaza brigade commander Izz al-Din al-Beik
humanCasualties: Al-Beik killed; al-Shifa Hospital said one more died of wounds; Gaza officials said six killed in Israeli fire that day.
misc: Israel killed Izz al-Din al-Beik, head of Hamas's armed wing in northern Gaza, in a strike on an apartment in Gaza City's Nasr neighbourhood; Netanyahu and Katz announced it and Hamas confirmed. Gaza Health Ministry says more than 1,400 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire; IDF says it killed 20+ Hamas members in September. Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/29/israeli-forces-kill-hamas-commander-izz-al-din-al-beik-in-gaza-attack ; GlobalSecurity (Israel PMO) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/09/09-29_index.htm

attacker: Unknown (Iran's PGSA said targets were on its non-compliance list)
target: Three tankers (Iran's PGSA described them as Emirati)
misc: FOG OF WAR: UKMTO said three tankers were struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Sept 29 amid renewed attacks on shipping. On Oct 1 Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority said the three Emirati tankers hit were already on its non-compliance list, and the IRGC said the US had not responded to its measures against violating vessels. Source: GlobalSecurity (RFE/RL, AZERTAC citing UKMTO) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/09-30_index.htm ; GlobalSecurity (Press TV) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/10/10-01_index.htm

target: Taibah power distribution station serving the Prophet's Mosque
misc: FOG OF WAR: The Saudi-led coalition said a Houthi drone struck the Taibah power distribution station in Madinah that supplies the Prophet's Mosque, a major escalation in the Houthi campaign against the kingdom. Pakistan called it a 'grave provocation', the GCC called it a flagrant violation of holy sites, and the UAE condemned it; Yemen's government army struck Sanaa afterward. Source: GlobalSecurity (Pakistan MOFA) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/10/10-02_index.htm ; Express Tribune https://tribune.com.pk/story/2632566/pakistan-calls-houthi-attack-on-madinah-power-station-grave-provocation ; GlobalSecurity (GCC) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/10/10-01_index.htm

Under 'Operation Economic Outcast' Treasury sanctioned 10 individuals/entities procuring weapons for Iran's MODAFL and State designated further Iran- and Russia-based entities, marking a year since UN snapback. Trump denied reports he offered sanctions relief or frozen funds for nuclear concessions, saying he offered Iran 'nothing'. Source: GlobalSecurity (US Treasury, State, RFE/RL) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/09-29_index.htm

FOG OF WAR: Houthi military spokesman said Saudi Arabia carried out 35 airstrikes across five Yemeni provinces in 24 hours as fighting intensified on several fronts; Press TV reported Saudi jets struck a school and villages. IOM said more than 145,000 people had been displaced in Yemen since West Coast fighting escalated in June. Source: GlobalSecurity (Press TV) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/09/09-29_index.htm ; GlobalSecurity (IOM) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/09/09-28_index.htm

CENTCOM completed the orderly departure of US forces and equipment from Erbil Air Base on Sept 30, ending the Operation Inherent Resolve mission in Iraq; Baghdad had set Sept 30 as the 'fixed and final' date and declared the coalition mission over. The IRGC, Hezbollah and Iraqi armed factions hailed it as an 'expulsion'; Kata'ib Sayyid al-Shuhada rejected disarmament. Source: GlobalSecurity (CENTCOM) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/09/09-30_index.htm ; Anadolu Agency https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/timeline-us-ends-military-presence-in-iraq-after-23-years/4073521

humanCasualties: Pilot (Indian national) seriously injured; co-pilot hospitalized; others safe.
misc: FOG OF WAR: On flydubai's Dubai-Tel Aviv flight the co-pilot attacked the pilot with a crash axe and tried to seize the controls; passengers subdued him and the plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia (reported near Tabuk; coordinates approximate). Israel and the UAE called it a terrorist attack; the UAE leads the probe and flydubai suspended Israel flights. Netanyahu said the attacker was Omani, unconfirmed by Oman. Source: NPR https://www.hppr.org/npr-news/2026-09-30/a-pilot-stabs-another-pilot-and-tries-to-crash-their-flight-to-tel-aviv-israel-says ; The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/09/30/flydubai-flight-to-tel-aviv-diverted-to-saudi-arabia-after-incident-on-board/

Iran received the US response to its seven-point plan via Qatari mediators; FM Araghchi presented the US proposal to President Pezeshkian at a cabinet meeting. On Oct 4 Iran said it was reviewing the US counter-proposal and would send additional points; US envoy Waltz called frozen funds and sanctions relief non-negotiable. Source: GlobalSecurity (RFE/RL) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/09-30_index.htm ; GlobalSecurity (IRNA) https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/10/10-04_index.htm

Press TV reported a new wave of Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon despite the framework truce with Hezbollah. UNICEF said four in five Lebanese households struggle to afford basics, and on Oct 1 that Israeli offensives since March had killed 261 children and wounded 1,056. Lebanon's Health Ministry put total deaths from Israeli attacks since March 2 above 4,300 (as of ~Oct 11). Source: GlobalSecurity (Press TV, UNICEF) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/09/09-30_index.htm ; GlobalSecurity (Press TV/UNICEF) https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2026/10/10-01_index.htm ; Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/11/two-killed-near-israeli-occupied-area-in-south-lebanon

misc: At least six Palestinians were killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza on Sept 30, per medical sources, amid continuing ceasefire violations.
